build_transformer_lm_model: build a TransformerLanguageModel instance using build_model with a fairseq task and config args
build_transformer_lm_embedding: build an Embedding layer for the transformer LM using build_embedding with a dictionary and embed_dim
configure_transformer_lm_big: configure the transformer_lm_big architecture with 12 layers and 1024 embedding dimension
configure_transformer_lm_gpt: configure the transformer_lm_gpt architecture with 768 embedding dim and gelu activation
configure_transformer_lm_gpt2_big: configure the transformer_lm_gpt2_big architecture with 48 layers and 1600 embedding dimension
